answer: One workable design: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because karst only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, island is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any terrace approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
